item.title: Power crisis strains Modilon Hospital, puts lives at risk
item.description: Madang Provincial Hospital says ongoing power outages are putting patients’ lives at risk and draining millions of kina from its already stretched health budget. Hospital management confirmed that repeated blackouts over the past few years have disrupted operations at the province’s main referral facility, which serves thousands of people across Madang and surrounding districts. item.title: Power cuts hit PNG manufacturers hard
item.description: Ongoing power outages are placing growing pressure on Papua New Guinea’s manufacturing sector, with rising energy costs threatening business survival. One of the country’s largest food producers says unreliable electricity is driving up production expenses and putting local companies at a disadvantage against cheaper imports.
